Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4410, Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2), mkinney seat (.claude-mkinney); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** There is one requested change (text only). The PR also conflicts with the newest `main`.

Review record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4410#issuecomment-7226633865

## Scope and tier

- The PR adds a catalog case, its three tests, a decision file and one generated guide line. It changes no product code.
- It adds two recorded programs (`rest.nc`, `rest.camproj`). It moves no golden.
- It has no UI change, no process file, no dependency, no `build.rs`, no script in `scripts/` and no workflow.
- A new recorded program is a program that a user can run. Thus I did the safety checks: two mutations and an independent check of `rest.nc`.

## What is good

- The case folder obeys `examples/catalog/README.md`. The model generator gives the committed `rest.obj` byte for byte.
- The script uses undoable commands only and stops if `cam.verify()` reports a finding.
- The tests are in the directory suite `example_catalog`. No new test binary.
- The decision file says what was chosen and dropped.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line, the mutations, "Goldens moved" and `Fixes #2867`.

## Results (local, host `m3`, trial merge of the head with `upstream/main` `bd7d06cbd`)

| Step | Result |

| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps, 0 failed |

Extra suites run (test data rule: each reader of `examples/catalog`):

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render` (it opens each catalog case): 2 passed, 1 ignored.
- The other readers (`plunge_depth_tab`, `operation::stamp_tests`, `xtask/tests/catalog.rs`) read `2d/contour-tabs` or a temporary tree. The new case cannot change them. I did not run them.

Heavy lanes: not run. They are not a merge condition. The body records `app heavy: example_catalog` (4 passed) on this head.

The gate ran with its compile cache on this host without the `can't find crate` failure that the body reports.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

1. Re-machining mask off (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:1374`, `mask_cols.as_ref().filter(|_| false)`): `regenerates` and `rebuilds` are red.
   ```
   3d/rest: 3D Pocket D6 rest holds blocking warnings: ["feed moves 334 and 481 cross in XY at shared depth"]
   ```
   The region pin stays green, because it reads the committed program. Restored: green.
2. One 6 mm move in `rest.nc` (line 1885) changed to `X5.79 Y-8.387 Z12.`: the three tests are red. The pin says:
   ```
   6 mm feed moves outside the rest region: [(5.79, -8.387, 12.0)]
   ```
   Restored: 47 passed.

## Independent check of `rest.nc` (2757 lines)

I wrote a separate height-map simulation (plain Python, outside the tree). It does not use CamCraft code.

- No move of the two tools goes below the model surface. No rapid goes through stock.
- Below `Z14.2`, no move puts a tool disc above a rib. The smallest XY clearance to a rib wall is 0.195 mm for each tool (0.2 mm stock to leave, less the chord error).
- No vertical `G01` removes stock.
- `3D Pocket D12`: levels `Z16`, `Z14.2`, `Z14`, `Z12`, `Z10`, `Z8`, `Z6`, `Z4.2`; 7,581 mm of feed. This agrees with the README.
- `3D Pocket D6 rest` starts at line 1573. Its levels are `Z14` to `Z4.2`; 1,421 mm of feed. The centre stays in `X-2.194..2.191`, `Y-17.409..17.636`. This agrees with the README.
- After the 12 mm operation, the material above the 0.2 mm stock to leave is 2,270 mm3, all in `X-4..4`, `Y-15..15`. The 6 mm operation removes exactly that volume and nothing outside it. After it, no location has more than 0.2 mm left.

Thus the claim of the issue is true: the second operation cuts only the rest region.

## Requested before merge

1. **The text says that rest material stands at the channel mouths. It does not.** Class: a statement in the documentation that the recorded program does not support.
   - `examples/catalog/3d/rest/README.md:41-42` says: "At the two mouths of the channel (`Y` near `-15` and `15`): the corners next to the rib ends that the 12 mm radius cannot reach."
   - The rib end corners at `X-4`/`X4`, `Y-15`/`Y15` are convex. A round tool goes around a convex corner, so there is no corner there that the 12 mm tool cannot reach.
   - A simulation with 0.1 mm cells at the `Y-15` mouth shows this after the 12 mm operation: the only material outside the channel is the 0.2 mm skin on the rib end faces (`Y-15.2..-15`), which is the stock to leave. The 6 mm operation leaves the same skin.
   - The 12 mm tool also cuts into the channel at each mouth. On the centre line it clears the floor to `Y-13.75` (the two 6.2 mm corner arcs meet at `Y-19.74`). So the rest region is the channel less a small curved area at each end. It is not the channel plus the mouths.
   - The 6 mm moves outside `|Y| > 15` (to `Y±17.7`) are the entry ramps and the ends of the ring pass. They go through space that the 12 mm tool cleared. They remove no material above the stock to leave.
   - The fix is text only. No recorded file changes. Correct each location that says the mouths are rest material:
     - `examples/catalog/3d/rest/README.md:41-42` (the drawing can stay: its `R` rows at lines 30 and 34 are on the channel end lines);
     - `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/case_3d_rest.rs:34-35` (doc comment: "and its two mouths");
     - `docs/decisions/2867-3d-rest-case.md:11` ("the channel and its two mouths");
     - the PR body ("It cuts only the channel and its two mouths").
   - Suggested README text: "The rest region is the channel: `X-4..4`, `Y-15..15`, from `Z14.2` down to the plate. At each end the 12 mm tool reaches a short distance into the channel (to `Y±13.75` on the centre line). The 6 mm tool enters at the two mouths, through space that the 12 mm tool cleared. Thus its centre goes to `Y±17.7`, but it cuts only in the channel."
   - The limits of the pin (`|X| <= 2.5`, `|Y| <= 18`) are correct for the entry moves and can stay.

2. **The PR conflicts with `main`.** `main` moved to `392980120` during this review (#4409 merged). `git merge-tree` shows one conflict: `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs` (the `include!` lines, as the body predicted). Keep the two lines. After the merge, run `cargo xtask catalog --check`; if it reports a difference, run `cargo xtask catalog --case 3d/rest` and name the change in the body.

## Follow-ups (file after merge; product behaviour, not caused by this PR)

- **Steep ramp at the cutting feed (suggested `P3`, `area:3d`).** At each level after the first, the 6 mm pocket starts with a ramp along the pass of 46.6 degrees (45.1 at the last level) that removes 2 mm of solid material at `F1200.` (lines 1880, 2055, 2230, 2405, 2580). `plunge_feed: 300` is in the script, but no `F300.` is in `rest.nc`. `3D Pocket1` of `3d/rough-finish` on `main` has no `F300.` also. `cam.verify()` passes this. The maintainer decides if a ramp this steep must use the plunge feed or a smaller angle. I found no issue that tracks it.
- **Entry ramps in air (suggested `P7`, `area:3d`).** At each level the 6 mm pocket ramps down from `Z20` at the two mouths, through space that is already clear (for example lines 1606-1676 and 1679-1878 for the first level). These moves are a large part of the 1,122 feed moves of the operation.

## Notes (not blocking)

- README lines 55-56: I confirmed the two cut lengths. I did not confirm "about 1.7 minutes" and "about 7.8 minutes". The feed moves alone give about 1.2 and 6.3 minutes; the difference can be the rapids and the tool change.
- `rest.camproj` keeps a relative model link (`"path": "model/rest.obj"`), the same as `3d/rough-finish`. `assert_portable_models` covers three other cases only. No change is necessary in this PR.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is far above 400 lines on `main`. This PR does not touch it.

## Labels

`needs-rework` and `conflicts`. The PR stays a draft. This review does not approve and does not merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
